A big star fox fan went and remaster the Star Fox Adventures manga "Farewell, Beloved Falco". The not not only upscale the pages making them higher render but they went and clean up the some of the english translation make it flow more naturally.

They did a really excellent job on this. It's pretty much my pefer way to read this manga now.
